headline: Base Transfers Stall in Center as Attrition Surges Across Front
war_summary: Since the midday dispatch, the rapid pace of territorial transfers in Linn of Mercy and Marban Hollow has ground to a halt, leaving both sectors without a single base flip in the past two hours despite persistent combat. Shifting pressures have instead produced fresh clashes elsewhere: Palantine Berm recorded another pair of exchanges over Vendett and Windburn Landing, while Godcrofts logged four recent transfers amid ongoing island combat. On the western front, Nevish Line and the Farranac Coast each marked late base movements, with Transient Valley drawing intense fighting as regional casualties spiked by nearly three thousand in two hours. Even where fortifications hold firm, casualty rates are mounting drastically. Callahan's Passage and Weathered Expanse endure blistering actions totaling upwards of twenty-three hundred casualties apiece over two hours, while the Dead Lands saw losses violently accelerate past sixteen hundred fallen. Across the Stlican Shelf, heavy attrition continues unabated, signaling that despite localized lulls in base seizures, operational pressure remains exceedingly severe across the entire frontline.
